text:
maria: quick brain-dump: propose a transfer-priority scheduler that factors transfer size, urgency, and tenant bandwidth quotas into host<->GPU evict/prefetch timing.
maria: motivation: we've seen large batch evictions stall small interactive requests when PCIe gets saturated.
jun: good callout. tail latency for interactive is what customers notice. how intrusive is this to allocator/evictor?
maria: minimal change: allocator emits a tiny hint at allocation/evict time: urgency=(interactive|normal|batch), est_bytes, allow_prefetch. runtime decides when to actually do the DMA.
sashank: fairness: need token-bucket windows per tenant/pool. otherwise one noisy tenant's tiny transfers could hog PCIe. also consider per-pool priority caps.
olivia: test surface: mixed workload microbench (40% seq64 interactive, 60% seq2048 batch). sweep tenant window sizes and measure p95/p99 for interactive. I can prototype quickly.
alex: incremental rollout plan: (1) add hint field in allocator (no behavior change), (2) add telemetry: inflight_bytes_by_tenant, queued_by_urgency, avg_transfer_size, (3) implement simple tenant token-buckets + an interactive flag that bypasses coalescing. low-risk.
jun: telemetry first. without it tuning windows is guesswork. add counters and a grafana panel.
sashank: topology matters: transfers crossing NUMA nodes or going through PCIe switch have higher effective cost. runtime should probe topology (hwloc/sysfs) and apply a multiplier to est_bytes.
maria: agreed. sample API sketch to land in RFC: (presented as text so it's just a hint)

AllocHint: "urgency": "interactive|normal|batch", "est_bytes": "uint64", "allow_prefetch": "bool"
RuntimeConfig: tenant_windows = {tenant_id: {window_bytes: 200000000, refill_ms: 1000}}

alex: watch out for compute batching alignment. If we preempt large transfers aggressively we might reduce kernel throughput. later we should fold compute-vs-transfer cost into scheduling cost.

olivia: I'll do a 2-day spike: prototype scheduler that enforces token-bucket and refuses to coalesce interactive items with batch drains. will run perf.sh --pattern mixed.
sashank: i'll add a small sysfs/hwloc helper snippet for topology multipliers and paste in the RFC.
jun: i'll add telemetry hooks and dashboards for the perf runs.
deploy-bot: infra-experiments/offload-transfer-priority canary started (no-prod).
maria: thanks — i'll draft an RFC with the incremental roadmap and link prototypes. please drop short bullets in the PR when you have spikes. :rocket:
